title: Crimson Castle 1.0.8
changes: Removed the debug panel from the public website and Android APK; desktop diagnostics remain available.
Added an Android hold-to-select control for selecting and aiming multiple guns together.
Updated group selection to support any number of guns; the X control clears all selected guns.
Added cheap solar panels, ground-placed powered water drillers, water storage tanks, and high-output geothermal generators.
